## 6.27 million DNA letters {.genome-slide}

::: {.deck-grid .deck-grid--two}
::: {.deck-card}
<div class="deck-number">6.27 Mb</div>

Draft genome of *D. tsuruhatensis* **MTQ3**, isolated from the tobacco rhizosphere—the soil around roots. [4]
:::
::: {.deck-card}
```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 0 440 180" role="img" aria-label="Schematic DNA fragments representing a draft genome, not a complete circular chromosome">
  <g fill="none" stroke="#E8954B" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M30 40h110m30 0h170M60 90h180m30 0h130M30 140h80m35 0h210"/>
  </g>
  <g stroke="#FFDA73" stroke-width="6">
    <path d="M60 25v30m40-30v30m100-30v30m50-30v30m50-30v30M100 75v30m50-30v30m50-30v30m100-30v30m50-30v30M60 125v30m120-30v30m50-30v30m50-30v30m50-30v30"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```

**Mb = million base pairs.** A genome is a starting point for testing what a microbe can do—not proof of every predicted function.
:::
:::

## 2 strains, different genome reports

::: {.deck-grid .deck-grid--two}
::: {.deck-card}
<h3>MTQ3 · 6.27 Mb</h3>

Draft genome; isolated from the tobacco rhizosphere. Described as a plant growth-promoting rhizobacterium. [4]
:::
::: {.deck-card}
<h3>HA60 · about 6.92 Mb</h3>

Complete circular chromosome; isolated from a commercial nano-hydroxyapatite product. [7]
:::
:::

Both are *D. tsuruhatensis*. These reports used different methods: **two isolates do not define every strain**, and isolation context does not prove a biological capability.

[Explore the published genome comparison](dashboard-genome-comparison.qmd)

---

## 3 genes connected to iron acquisition

A study of MTQ3 used gene knockouts to identify **three nonribosomal peptide synthetase genes involved in siderophore production**. [5]

::: {.deck-grid}
::: {.deck-card}
<span class="deck-icon" aria-hidden="true">🧬</span>
### Genes
Test a gene's contribution by disrupting it.
:::
::: {.deck-card}
<span class="deck-icon" aria-hidden="true">⚗️</span>
### Molecules
Siderophores bind iron.
:::
::: {.deck-card}
<span class="deck-icon" aria-hidden="true">🌱</span>
### Interactions
Ask how iron acquisition affects life around roots.
:::
:::

This is evidence for a studied strain, not a universal trait of *Delftia*.

## 2025 · “Where is Delftia?”

::: {.deck-grid .deck-grid--two}
::: {}
![Spot plate showing bacterial growth in a Delftia Project laboratory activity.](images/Spot_Plate_10ul_48hrs.jpg){.deck-photo}

A **2025 education publication** brings citizen science into biotechnology and environmental science curricula. [6]

Students also helped discover gold-precipitating bacterial lineages in earlier work. [3]

**Observe → investigate → share**

The next big question can start in a classroom.

## 62 million metric tonnes

::: {.deck-grid .deck-grid--two}
::: {}
<div class="deck-number">62 billion kg</div>

The world's electronic waste in **2022**. [1]

This global challenge is one motivation for studying new approaches to material recovery—not a measure of what *Delftia* can recycle.
:::
::: {.deck-card}

## 22.3% formally collected and recycled

```{=html}
<div class="recycling-bar" role="img" aria-label="Of global e-waste generated in 2022, 22.3 percent was documented as formally collected and recycled; 77.7 percent was not">
  <span class="recycling-bar-collected"></span>
  <span class="recycling-bar-other"></span>
</div>
```

**22.3% documented** · **77.7% not documented** [1]

“Not documented” does **not** mean all was dumped: informal handling and tracking gaps also matter.

Responsible collection and recycling matter **today**, while researchers investigate future possibilities.

---

## Gold is one remarkable example

::: {.deck-grid}
::: {.deck-card}
<h3>1 · Dissolved gold</h3>

Gold can be toxic to bacteria.
:::
::: {.deck-card}
<h3>2 · Delftibactin</h3>

*D. acidovorans* releases a molecule that binds gold.
:::
::: {.deck-card}
<h3>3 · Solid particles</h3>

Gold changes form; it is **not created from nothing**. [2]
:::
:::

**A laboratory finding, not a proven e-waste solution.** This does not establish safe, cheap recovery from mixed electronics at industrial scale.
